title: Glowing paintbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Paintbrush handle -->
  <rect x="42" y="18" width="16" height="42" rx="4" fill="#4a90d9"/>
  <rect x="44" y="20" width="4" height="38" rx="2" fill="#6ab0f5"/>
  <rect x="52" y="20" width="4" height="38" rx="2" fill="#3a70b9"/>
  <!-- Ferrule (metal band) -->
  <rect x="39" y="55" width="22" height="10" rx="2" fill="#c0c8d0"/>
  <rect x="41" y="57" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#e8eef4"/>
  <rect x="55" y="57" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#a0a8b8"/>
  <!-- Bristles -->
  <path d="M41 65 Q42 80 44 88 Q48 92 50 85 Q52 78 53 65 Z" fill="#f5c542"/>
  <path d="M43 67 Q45 78 46 84 Q48 86 49 80 Q49 72 50 67 Z" fill="#fae06a"/>
  <!-- Glow around bristles -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="82" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#ffe87a" opacity="0.35"/>
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="82" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#fff3a0" opacity="0.4"/>
  <!-- Paint blob on bristles -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="84" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="84" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#ff9cc0"/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="68" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="92" r="1.5" fill="#ffe87a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="90" r="2" fill="#ffe87a"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="60" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="56" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Drip of paint -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="93" rx="2.5" ry="3.5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="93" rx="1.5" ry="2" fill="#ffb8d4"/>
</svg>
